html:
The In and Out sauce recipe is one of the most searched fast-food copycat recipes in the world—and for good reason. This creamy, tangy, slightly sweet burger spread has become iconic thanks to In-N-Out Burger, a staple of California fast food and West Coast burgers culture. Whether you call it In N Out sauce, In-N-Out burger sauce, In-N-Out spread recipe, or the legendary In-N-Out secret sauce, one thing is certain: it transforms ordinary burgers into unforgettable animal style burgers.

This guide breaks down how to make In-N-Out sauce at home, why it tastes so good, how it compares to Thousand Island dressing ingredients, and all the ways you can customize it keto, low-carb, vegan, gluten-free, and even spicy. We’ll also cover storage, serving ideas, and creative uses beyond burgers.

 What Is In And Out Sauce Recipe?

In-N-Out sauce is a creamy burger spread made from mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, and sweet pickle relish.
This simple blend creates a burger spread sauce that balances richness, acidity, and sweetness perfectly.

It’s often referred to as:

  • Animal style sauce

  • In-N-Out secret sauce

  • Fast food burger sauce

  • California burger sauce

  • Cheeseburger spread

  • Hamburger sauce

While it’s similar to Thousand Island dressing, many fans argue that In-N-Out spread is tangier, less sweet, and more mustard-forward, making it ideal for burgers and fries.

 The History Behind In-N-Out Burger Sauce

In-N-Out Burger represents more than just a meal it’s a symbol of American fast food culture, classic burger joints, and iconic drive-thru burgers. Founded in California, the brand became famous for fresh ingredients, a short menu, and its not-so-secret animal style burgers topped with extra sauce.

The animal style sauce recipe quickly gained cult status, leading to endless searches for:

  • Copycat In-N-Out sauce

  • Homemade In-N-Out burger sauce

  • Burger sauce like In-N-Out

 Ingredients for in and out sauce recipe

 Core Ingredients (Classic Version)

To make an authenticIn-N-Out sauce recipe, you’ll need:

  • Mayonnaise

  • Ketchup

  • Yellow mustard

  • Sweet pickle relish

  • Dill pickle relish

  • White vinegar

  • Sugar

  • Salt

  • Black pepper

  • Paprika

  • Garlic powder

  • Onion powder

These ingredients mirror classic Thousand Island dressing ingredients, but with adjusted ratios for a sharper, burger-friendly taste.

 Optional Flavor Enhancers

  • Extra paprika for warmth

  • More yellow mustard for tang

  • A pinch of sugar to balance acidity

 Equipment Needed (No-Cook Sauce)

This is a no-cook sauce, meaning no heat, no stove, and no mess.

 Basic Tools

  • Mixing bowl

  • Whisking ingredients

  • Spoon for stirring sauce

  • Airtight container for refrigerator storage

 How to Make In-N-Out Sauce at Home

 Step-by-Step Method (5-Minute Sauce)

This is a true quick sauce recipe that takes less than five minutes.

Step 1 – Combine Base Ingredients

Add mayonnaise, ketchup, and yellow mustard to a mixing bowl.

 Step 2 – Add Pickles and Seasoning

Stir in sweet pickle relish, dill pickle relish, white vinegar, sugar, salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.

 Step 3 – Whisk Until Smooth

Continue whisking ingredients until creamy and fully blended.

 Step 4 – Chill and Rest

Cover and place in the fridge for chilling sauce. Allow resting sauce time of at least 30 minutes for best flavor.

 Why Chilling Improves Flavor

Letting the sauce rest allows flavors to blend and mellow. While it’s a 5-minute sauce, chilling enhances that authentic restaurant-style burger sauce at home taste.

 Is In-N-Out Spread Just Thousand Island?

 Key Differences Explained

Is In-N-Out spread just Thousand Island?
Not exactly.

Feature In-N-Out Sauce Thousand Island Dressing
Sweetness Mild Sweeter
Texture Thicker Thinner
Mustard Flavor Stronger Minimal
Use Burger sauce Salad dressing

The In-N-Out secret sauce recipe is designed specifically for burgers.

 Animal Style Sauce Explained

 What Is Animal Style Sauce?

Animal style sauce is commonly used on burgers, fries, and sandwiches.
It’s the same base sauce, often with extra mustard or pickle flavor.

 How Do You Make Animal Style Sauce at Home?

Simply increase:

  • Mustard

  • Pickle relish

  • Black pepper

This version is perfect for animal style burgers and animal style fries.

 Best Ways to Use In-N-Out Sauce

 Classic Uses

  • Burger sauce for grilled burgers

  • Cheeseburger spread

  • Hamburger sauce

  • Smash burgers

  • Fries dipping sauce

 Beyond Burgers

  • Sandwich spread

  • Wraps

  • Veggie burgers

  • Breakfast sandwiches

 3 Ingredient Burger Sauce

  • Mayonnaise

This 3 ingredient burger sauce is quick, simple, and beginner-friendly.

 Spicy In-N-Out Sauce

Add:

  • Chili powder

This creates a bold spicy In-N-Out sauce perfect for grilled burgers.

 Keto and Low-Carb Options

 Keto In-N-Out Sauce

  • Sugar-free ketchup

  • No sugar or minimal sweetener

  • Full-fat mayo

 Sugar-Free Burger Sauce

Ideal for keto diets and low-carb sauce alternatives.

 Vegan and Dairy-Free Sauce Options

 Vegan Burger Sauce Alternative

  • Vegan mayonnaise

  • Plant-based ketchup

  • Pickle relish

 Dairy-Free Sauce (With Substitutes)

The original sauce is naturally dairy-free, but always check your mayo brand.

 Gluten-Free Sauce Explained

Is In-N-Out sauce gluten-free?
Yes when all ingredients (especially relish and ketchup) are certified gluten-free.

 Storage and Shelf Life

 Can I Store Homemade In-N-Out Sauce?

Yes.

 How Long Does Burger Sauce Last in the Fridge?

  • Stored in an airtight container: 5–7 days

  • Always use refrigerator storage

 FAQs About In-N-Out Sauce Recipe

 What Is In-N-Out Sauce Made Of?

It’s made from mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, and sweet pickle relish.

 Can I Make a Low-Carb In-N-Out Sauce?

Yes, by using sugar-free ketchup and skipping sugar.

 What Can I Use In-N-Out Sauce on Besides Burgers?

Fries, sandwiches, wraps, veggie burgers, and grilled vegetables.

 Why This Is the Best In and out Sauce Recipe

This best In-N-Out sauce recipe:

  • Takes under five minutes

  • Uses pantry staples

  • Matches fast food copycat sauces

  • Works for burgers, fries, and sandwiches

It delivers classic fast food flavors without preservatives and fits into modern homemade condiments trends.

 Final Thoughts

Whether you’re recreating In-N-Out Burger magic at home or just looking for a creamy burger spread, this In-N-Out sauce recipe is the ultimate solution. From animal style sauce for burgers to restaurant-style burger sauce at home, this copycat delivers authentic flavor, flexibility, and nostalgia all in one bowl.
